prerequisites.value: Snarecrafter Dedication or Snare Specialist ranger class feat

special.value:
You can't select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the snarecrafter or trapsmith archetypes.
Leads to: Finessed Features|G&G, Gear Gnash|G&G, Propeller Attachment|G&G, Recycled Cogwheels|G&G, Repurposed Parts|G&G

description.value: You use glimmering gears and gnashing mechanisms to manufacture snares using specialized parts. Your snares include clockwork and steam-powered cogwheels and gears, and their gush of steam can hinder those you ensnare. If you choose to construct a snare using gears and a creature fails their saving throw against the snare, all creatures are concealed to that creature for 1 round, as a burst of steam obscures its vision.
